**Finding: Deviation (INDEMN — critical)**

Section 12 does contain a TrueLink-side indemnity (p0073/p0075), so this is not a "missing" clause — but it is scoped only to TrueLink's breach of the Agreement or failure to perform. Because no TrueLink non-infringement warranty exists anywhere in the document (section 9 warranties are Y2K-only; the only infringement reps run from Client at p0055), a breach-triggered indemnity gives us no protection against third-party IP claims over the Interface and related software. That excludes IP infringement entirely and so fails even the playbook fallback, while Client's indemnity at p0071–p0072 remains very broad.

Redline (validated, ok:true) extends p0075 to cover IP infringement with the customary Client Content / modification-and-combination carve-outs, plus TrueLink's violation of law, unauthorized access to Client data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and adds a standard defend/notice/control/cooperation mechanic. Fallback offered in the comment: IP-only indemnity with procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
